comment:
If AI is integrated into Buckets I'd probably (very sadly) stop using it. Considering the damage it does to the environment (data centers that power it run on diesel generators, for christ sake), as well as to poor communities that these data centers are forced into, and the theft it's built on, there is no ethical use of AI. 

If you feel you must use it, please leave us an untouched by AI version of Buckets.  It doesn't need any more features.  It's great now just the way it is.
